tagline: ai parse document now returns more detailed figure descriptions.
what_it_does: ai parse document now returns more detailed figure descriptions. For charts, the description also includes the chart data as structured JSON, such as series values and legend labels. Applies to: Databricks SQL Databricks Runtime The ai parse document() function leverages state of the art Databricks managed research techniques to parse structured content from unstructured documents.
why_it_matters: + The ai parse document function is also available to workspaces with the Enhanced Security and Compliance add on.
plain_summary: ai parse document now returns more detailed figure descriptions. For charts, the description also includes the chart data as structured JSON, such as series values and legend labels.
